newsitem.title: USA: National Datacomputer to be relisted.
newsitem.headline: National Datacomputer to be relisted.

text.p: National Datacomputer Inc said Monday that the Nasdaq has granted conditional approval to its request to be relisted on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market.
Prior to being relisted, the company must maintain a minimum bid price of $3.00 per share for 15 consecutive trading days, it said.
In the past year, the company's stock has traded between a low of 3/4 and a high of 5-5/8. It was trading Monday afternoon at about 1-3/8.
The company did not immediately return a telephone call seeking further information.
National Datacomputer designs, manufactures, markets and services computers, data collection devices and peripherals.
